title: Delegation
description: A user's standing consent for a template to act on their behalf when they are not present (schedules, events, continuations). See ../../platform.md §8.

principal.description: The user granting it. Always the authenticated caller of POST /v1/delegations.

max_version.description: Omitted: versions published later need fresh consent only if they widen scopes or servers.

scopes.description: MCP server id to the OBO scopes consented for it. Must be within the template's declared scopes.

constraints.description: Optional narrowing on params, as param name to allowed values (a repository, a project).

consented_spec_digest.description: Of the servers, scopes and write tools shown at consent. A later version whose digest of these differs needs re-consent.
